item.title: Crewe Alexandra 2-1 Tranmere Rovers | Match Report
item.description: Full-time: Crewe Alexandra 2-1 Tranmere Rovers Tommi O’Reilly was the standout player for Crewe in the first half, and he had the first shot on target of the afternoon, forcing Marko Marosi into a near-post save. James Plant gave Rovers the lead in the 44th minute with his first goal for the Club, riffling the ball home left-footed, nutmegging Ian Lawlor. item.title: Tranmere Rovers Women 0 Crewe Alexandra Women 1 | Match Report
item.description: Rovers exited the Cheshire Cup at the Quarter Final stage following defeat in a tight encounter. Tranmere started brightly with Ashleigh Bullock latching onto a loose ball at the back from the visitors before seeing her low shot saved by Crewe keeper Hannah Holloway. item.title: Newport County 3-1 Tranmere Rovers | Match Report
item.description: Full-time: Newport County 3-1 Tranmere Rovers Rovers started on the front foot with Zech Obiero, playing as the most advanced central midfielder, winning a corner kick. From the set play, the ball came out to Sam Finley, who found the far bottom-left corner with a scissor kick for a third-minute lead. item.title: Club Statement - Andy Crosby
item.description: Tranmere Rovers can confirm that Andy Crosby has been relieved of his duties as first team manager with immediate effect. Chairman Mark Palios said: “Andy did a great job for us last year and has undoubtedly been dealt a tough hand this season with the exceptionally high level of injuries we have experienced.
